faq.headline: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: Is this really a one-time payment?
faq.a1: Yes. We hate subscriptions as much as you do. You pay once and own this version of FluxDM forever on your machine.
faq.a2: Currently, FluxDM is optimized for Windows. A Mac version is in development. Join the waitlist to be notified.
faq.q3: Is it safe for my account?
faq.a3: 100%. Since FluxDM runs locally and uses human-like typing delays, it mimics real user behavior. We do not use unauthorized API calls that trigger bans.
